volumes.title: Immediate Survival & Field Trauma Core
volumes.description: Critical first-30-days protocols: water filtration, hemorrhage control, improvised shelter, emergency firecraft, pathogens, and emergency triage.
volumes.sourceAttribution: CivZero Core Field Manual & Tactical Medicine Corps

volumes.title: Agrarian, Masonry & Primitive Metallurgy
volumes.description: Post-collapse food self-sufficiency: heirloom seed saving, anaerobic lacto-fermentation, adobe forges, greensand metal casting, hydraulic ram pumps, and quicklime masonry.
volumes.sourceAttribution: Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) & Pre-Industrial Craft Guild Archives

volumes.title: Complete Clinical Medicine & Operative Trauma Surgery
volumes.description: Hospital-grade medical reference: emergency field surgery, anatomical dissection, sterile technique, pharmacology compounding, infectious disease management, and obstetrics.
volumes.sourceAttribution: World Health Organization (WHO) Surgical Care, Merck Manual, & British Pharmacopeia

volumes.title: Mechanical, Civil & Chemical Engineering Handbooks
volumes.description: Comprehensive heavy industrial blueprint archive: machine shop lathe tooling, steam and hydro turbine fluid mechanics, structural steel truss calculations, internal combustion, and electrical dynamos.
volumes.sourceAttribution: Marks' Standard Handbook for Mechanical Engineers & Machinery's Handbook

volumes.title: Complete English Wikipedia Civilization Archive
volumes.description: The entire English Wikipedia encyclopedia: 6.8 million articles stripped of web styling, complete with cross-reference index, tables, and vector schematics for universal knowledge restoration.
volumes.sourceAttribution: Wikimedia Foundation Official Data Dumps & OpenZIM Project

volumes.title: Open-Source Appropriate Technology & Historical Patents
volumes.description: Hundreds of thousands of low-capital, intermediate technologies: blacksmithing, water wheels, textile looms, windmills, clay kilns, and expired 19th-century mechanical patents.
volumes.sourceAttribution: Appropedia Foundation & The Survivor Library Public Domain Repository

volumes.title: Mathematics, Physics, Semiconductor Lithography & Computing
volumes.description: Complete foundation of mathematical analysis, quantum physics, semiconductor crystal growing, MOSFET transistor lithography, digital logic design, and artificial intelligence models.
volumes.sourceAttribution: MIT OpenCourseWare Archive & Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers

volumes.title: Global Botanical Agronomy, Soil Sciences & Crop Pathology
volumes.description: Comprehensive agronomy guide: identifying 40,000+ edible, medicinal, and fibrous plant species, natural pest defense, soil microbiology, and multi-century seed storage techniques.
volumes.sourceAttribution: Consultative Group on International Agricultural Research (CGIAR) & USDA
